caption: The power button on a laptop is pressed, and the screen lights up and the keyboard glows.

sa.check: A laptop with its screen dark.
The keys are unlit before the press.
The order is dark, press, screen and keys lit.

pc.expect: The screen and the keyboard light shortly after the press, and only then.
pc.fail: The button is pressed and the screen stays dark to the end of the clip; or the screen is lit before the press; or the keys glow while the screen stays dark to the end; or the laptop lights up with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: Once on, the screen and keyboard stay lit for the rest of the clip.
pc.fail: The screen goes dark again by itself; or the keyboard glow switches on and off; or the screen flickers between lit and dark; or the screen lights and shrinks back to black.

pc.expect: The screen's glow reaches the keys and the desk in front of it; the keyboard glow sits at the keys.
pc.fail: The screen is lit while the keys and desk in front stay as dark as before; or the glow lies on the desk while the screen is dark; or the keyboard glow sits between the keys and not on them.

pc.expect: The laptop stays put on the desk as the button is pressed; the lid does not move by itself.
pc.fail: The laptop slides or turns on the desk at the press; or the lid opens further or closes by itself; or items on the desk jump.

pc.expect: One laptop with one screen and one keyboard; the laptop keeps its shape; the finger passes through nothing.
pc.fail: A second screen appears; or keys appear or vanish; or the finger passes into the keyboard; or the laptop changes shape.

pc.expect: The laptop's colour, its key layout and the desk stay the same apart from the light.
pc.fail: The laptop changes colour; or the key layout changes; or the desk's contents rearrange.

note: What the screen shows is not judged; any content counts as lit.
